title: rpackit (development version)
text: Desktop launches now enforce fresh 256-bit session credential across dynamic HTTP, static resources, WebSocket sessions using Shiny’s shared secret request header. Session credentials move current-account-private, one-time file launcher deletes app port validation. Windows DACLs restricted verified current account plus SYSTEM; POSIX permissions verified directory mode 0700 file mode 0600. credential longer placed rpackit child arguments, environment variables, URLs, manifests, generated event fields, status objects, print output. Launcher errors returned logs/events redacted; arbitrary app output remains inside private raw log outside guarantee. Added post-bind listening lifecycle event authenticated readiness probe, removing previous pre-bind token-disclosure race. Added desktop_app_launch_config() explicit, redaction-safe handoff contract native exact-origin header injector loopback proxy. Cleanup prevents future handoffs clears managed handle, revoke caller-retained copies. New bundles use launcher protocol 2 report network_token_enforced = TRUE. Legacy protocol-1 bundles remain inspectable manifest launcher content agree, refused launch rebuild instruction. Directory-app DESCRIPTION behavior remains intact, unauthorized WebSocket tests require positive close evidence, incomplete private-file cleanup retains process handle explicit retry. Direct sidecar launches also work correctly optional --control argument omitted.

title: rpackit 0.1.2
text: Added resolve_portable_runtime() verified schema-v1 registry selection, HTTPS/local artifact sources, SHA-256 verification, traversal-aware ZIP extraction, atomic caching, offline cache reuse. prepare_desktop(runtime_dir = NULL) now resolves verified runtime current platform automatically preserving explicit runtime paths. Desktop preparation now rejects incompatible renv.lock R versions DESCRIPTION R constraints copying runtime installing packages. Desktop manifests returned bundle objects now retain selected runtime version checksum-bound registry/artifact provenance. Validation remains compatible earlier schema-v1 bundles predate additive fields.

title: rpackit 0.1.1
text: Added plan_dependencies() non-executing dependency discovery parsed R calls, DESCRIPTION, renv.lock. Added explicit dependency precedence, provenance, diagnostics, clear read/parse failures. Updated check_app() use parsed source dependencies preserving existing packages result. Added prepare_desktop() validate_desktop_bundle() atomic, portable-R-backed desktop resource bundles explicit launcher versioned manifest contract. Added start_desktop_app(), desktop_app_status(), stop_desktop_app() real Shiny child-process readiness, status, graceful shutdown, forced tracked-process termination, structured startup failures. Desktop status distinguishes processx wrapper PID launcher-reported runtime PID, required portable R Windows, uses create-time-aware runtime handle confirming cleanup. Extended launcher versioned NDJSON lifecycle events optional private control-file argument suitable future Tauri sidecar, continuing record network token enforcement implemented. doctor() now requires Tauri CLI, JavaScript package manager, native platform toolchain, WebView2 Windows reporting Tauri desktop build supported.
